install.note: Detect the actual copilot executable first. gh.exe is GitHub CLI, and GitHub Copilot Desktop is a separate installation; neither proves copilot CLI is installed. Prefer the official native installer where available. For npm, verify the current package engines before installing Node. Verify copilot --version. CLI login uses copilot login; BYOK can run without GitHub sign-in. EchoBird changes only its own provider and model entries in providers.json and the explicitly selected default model. Respect COPILOT_HOME and COPILOT_PROVIDERS_CONFIG.
